title: Bruse Tarl & Falthis — The Butcher's Masquerade
summary: Morph masquerade: hide the board behind face-down 2/2s, then unmask for free with Skirk Alarmist while Panoptic Projektor doubles the payoff.

tags.name: morph
tags.reason: Twenty-six morph cards plus Skirk Alarmist, Panoptic Projektor, Dream Chisel, Goblin Maskmaker, Roshan, and Veiled Ascension built around them.

tags.name: face-down
tags.reason: The whole board deploys face down; unmasking timing is the deck's central decision.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Three finite five-card Extreme Plans are documented in the primer; a fourth named package is a political value line.

tags.name: forced combat
tags.reason: Disrupt Decorum, Kardur, Agitator Ant, and Bloodthirsty Blade goad the table into hunting each other.

tags.name: toolbox
tags.reason: Five tutors plus Sunforger assemble situational morph answers such as Skinthinner, Aphetto Exterminator, and Bane of the Living.

tags.name: aggro
tags.reason: The primary win is a masked alpha strike at +4/+4 rather than an engine grind.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Goad and Wishclaw Talisman make table negotiation part of every turn.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Goblin Bombardment, Diabolic Intent, Gift of Doom, and Skirk Alarmist all convert bodies into effects.

tags.name: equipment
tags.reason: Basilisk Collar, Loxodon Warhammer, Mask of Memory, Sunforger, and Bloodthirsty Blade back the combat plan.

tags.name: attack triggers
tags.reason: Bruse Tarl, Ebonblade Reaper, Mask of Memory, Goblin Maskmaker, and Silent Specter all key off attacking.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Ponyback Brigade and Kirtar's Wrath make tokens, but they are Bombardment fodder rather than a plan.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Soul Collector steals creatures it kills, but it is one card rather than a repeating axis.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: Curve and pace are midrange, though the deck is pointed at one telegraphed alpha strike.

tags.name: cats
tags.reason: Falthis is a Cat because Princess Donut is; there is no Cat package.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Commander damage is a fallback route, not a build direction.
